# 7475 - Quadruple bistable latch

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7475.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7475.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 17 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7475 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7475.png) | ![7475 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7475.png) | ![7475 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7475.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /1Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 2 | 1D | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 2D | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | G34 | enable | high |  | controls pins 10, 11, 9, 8; when not enabled: hold; ENABLE 3-4: latches 3 and 4 follow D while high, store while low |
| 5 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 6 | 3D | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | 4D | input |  |  |  |
| 8 | /4Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 4Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | 3Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 11 | /3Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 12 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 13 | G12 | enable | high |  | controls pins 16, 1, 15, 14; when not enabled: hold; ENABLE 1-2: latches 1 and 2 follow D while high, store while low |
| 14 | /2Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 15 | 2Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 16 | 1Q | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 1Q = state1 | Latch 1 bit. |
| 1 | /1Q = NOT state1 | Inverse of 1Q. |
| 15 | 2Q = state2 | Latch 2 bit. |
| 14 | /2Q = NOT state2 | Inverse of 2Q. |
| 10 | 3Q = state3 | Latch 3 bit. |
| 11 | /3Q = NOT state3 | Inverse of 3Q. |
| 9 | 4Q = state4 | Latch 4 bit. |
| 8 | /4Q = NOT state4 | Inverse of 4Q. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: level of G12 (latches 1, 2) and G34 (latches 3, 4)

- G high: Q = D, Q' = NOT D (transparent)
- G low: Q holds the level it had before the high-to-low transition of G

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulse width high | G12,G34 |  | 20 |
| setup | D | G high-to-low | 20 |
| hold | D | G high-to-low | 5 |

## Notes

The datasheet table gives setup 20 ns and hold 5 ns without naming the reference edge; the high-to-low transition of G is the edge the function table says the data is kept at. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
